$comment: First-party API $/MTok for audit.mjs. Re-verify against the source when a model ships or audit.mjs warns of an unpriced model. The cost-state total runs ~10% under by scope (#116), so it is no price check; the per-model check on cost-state's own tokens is (#141). A model's "longPrompt" is the tier whose prices replace the base ones for a request with more than "over" prompt tokens (input + cache write + cache read). A model's "exception" is a price Claude Code charges that differs from the published one: dated, named for the fix it waits on, and reported as an exception, not drift.

exception.waitsOn: Claude Code correcting its Sonnet 5.5 cache-read price to the published $0.10 (CC 2.1.296 already does; drop this once no audited cost-state is from CC 2.1.295 or older)
